evidence.summary: Two-angle filmstrips + run_luau probe: 0-deg loop seam (frame6==frame1), subtle 3-6deg head-bow/torso-breathe/arm-sway, feet planted no slide, no clipping.

reasons: Loop seam numerically 0 deg: last keypose exactly re-snaps the first, filmstrip frame at 5.60s identical to 0.00s from both angles
Motion confined to a natural 3-6 deg breathing/weight-shift band across 16 posed joints, no foot-slide (feet counter-rotated 3 deg, no lateral base drift)
Reads as a gentle contemplative idle from front AND right angles: head bow + torso breathe + slight arm sway, no limb clipping
5 keyframes, loop=true, priority=Movement per config; all verified edit-mode without needing a playtest

steps: Keypose0 t=0: subtle grounded rest (Waist x-1, Neck x1, hips/ankles ±1 counter-rotated, shoulders ±4) — key all 8 breathing joints
Keypose1 t=1.4: inhale peak + weight shift left (Waist x-3 z2 chest rise, head lift, hips z3, ankles z-3 counter, shoulders ±6 sway)
Keypose2 t=2.8: exhale settled on left hip (Waist x1 z3, Neck x4 gaze down, hips z4, ankles z-4, shoulders ±3)
Keypose3 t=4.2: second inhale drifting back to center (Waist x-3, Neck x2, hips z2, ankles z-2, shoulders ±5)
Keypose4 t=5.6: re-snapshot exact keypose0 for seamless loop seam
Set Loop=true, Priority=Movement; capture_animation front+right — feet planted, gentle arc, frame1==last

recipe.text: Contemplative breathing idle authored purely via Motor6D pose_joint rotations in a ~1-7 degree band. Two breath cycles with a slow weight-shift onto the left hip and a downward gaze at the settle, arms swaying subtly with the breath. Hips and ankles counter-rotated at every keypose to keep both feet planted (verified no foot-slide from front and side filmstrips). Loop closed by re-snapshotting the exact first keypose as the final keyframe at t=5.6 (=t=0), giving a seamless seam. All 8 animated joints keyed at every keyframe. Loop=true, Priority=Movement.
